verses.gurmukhi: ੧੭ : ਮੂਰਖ ਰੀਸ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 17 : moorakh rees dhaa fal bhogadhaa hai

en.bdb: The foolish undergoes the results of imitation

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਹੈ ਦੇ ਪੁਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadhev dhee sev kar var paiaa saahai dhe putai|

en.bdb: The son of a banker served Mahadev and got a boon (of attaining wealth).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਬੁ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਰੇਵੜੈ ਆਇ ਵੜੇ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharab saroop sarevaRai aai vaRe ghar a(n)dhar utai|

en.bdb: Wealth came to his house in the guise of sadhus of gramanic tradition.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਹਥਿਆਰੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦਰਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਧੜ ਧੁਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau hathiaaree maareean tiau tiau dharab hoh dhaR dhutai|

en.bdb: As they were beaten, heaps of money emerged there in his house.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਡਿਠਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਈ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੁਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: butee karadhe ddiThion naiee chain na baiThe sutai|

en.bdb: A barber working in the house also saw this scene and he becoming restive lost his sleep.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਰੇਵੜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਅਛੁਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: maare aan sarevaRe sun dheebaan masaan achhutai|

en.bdb: Availing an opportunity he killed all the sadhus and the matter of the innocent victims came to the court of law.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਥੈ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਆ ਵਾਲ ਛਡਾਇਨ ਕਿਸ ਦੈ ਬੁਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: mathai vaal pachhaaRiaa vaal chhaddain kis dhai butai|

en.bdb: Catching hold from his hair he was thrashed. Now by what power he will give rescued from that clutch.
The foolish sows seeds out of season (and suffers loss).
